card.name: The n in nelfinavir
card.fires_on: The lone letter n that begins the drug name nelfinavir, usually in a list of HIV protease inhibitors. A few weaker cases are the period ending a sentence before another antiviral name.

modes.description: A period after a co-administration warning, just before the next antiviral drug name.
